findings.description: The bucket is not configured with server-side encryption, so objects stored (including the customer-master.xlsx data object) are at rest in cleartext. This exposes sensitive customer data if the bucket or a copy of its data is exfiltrated.
The bucket is explicitly noted as public and no public access block or bucket policy restriction limits access; combined with its unencrypted contents this exposes customer data to anyone.
This object stores a customer-master.xlsx file (likely containing sensitive customer data) in a bucket that is public and unencrypted, exposing the data to unauthenticated access.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configured, leaving financial data at rest in cleartext.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configured, leaving its data at rest in cleartext even though versioning is enabled.
The data_science bucket has no server-side encryption configured, leaving its data at rest in cleartext.
